people.name: Edom
people.line: Descendants of Esau; enemy nation southeast of Israel

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Thus Edom refused to give Israel passage through his border, so Israel turned away from him.
translations.bsb: So Edom refused to allow Israel to pass through their territory, and Israel turned away from them.
translations.kjv: Thus Edom refused to give Israel passage through his border: wherefore Israel turned away
translations.asv: Thus Edom refused to give Israel passage through his border: wherefore Israel turned away from him.
